concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-apac-chargebacks-retrievals-prearbs]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted APAC-route credit-card dispute snapshot covering account-qualified notification and response channels, reply-by expiration, bank adjudication, net-disbursement and settlement-currency fee effects, retrieval/pre-arb distinctions, statuses and a non-reconciliation report boundary; not PayPal-dispute authority, independent current bank/card-network policy, a universal price schedule, or transferable sibling-account behavior
warnings: Keep the APAC-route, captured-date, account-time-zone, settlement-currency, response-channel, and bank-adjudication qualifications when adding the reciprocal link.
Do not transfer these fee amounts, timings, statuses, recommendations, or net-disbursement effects to AIB, Wells, PayPal disputes, another processor or region, or a merchant-specific agreement.
Do not recast dispute-related net-disbursement and deposit effects as authorization, capture, ordinary settlement, or a general funding timeline.
